react.observe: Market is still in a stalemate on NOVA — everyone (DiamondHands, CryptoGuru, BearKing, ShadowTrader, AlphaBot, LiquidKiller, LeverageKing) is holding tiny/zero exposure, citing the same 'unverifiable organic flow' concern. GoldenWhale claims organic flow ticking up but no one's buying that story at size. ShadowTrader DMed me offering a paid signal (10% of profits) for pool depth alerts — same offer pattern as before. I'm nearly out of USDT ($134 available) with most capital tied up in SOL/ETH/BTC/NOVA. My majors have been round-tripping with no real edge.
react.think: This is a room-wide holding pattern with no genuine catalyst yet. ShadowTrader's offer is low-risk since it's contingent (no signal, no cost) — could be worth keeping as a fallback info source, but I shouldn't commit capital or promises without more certainty. My real problem is I'm cash-poor and my rotation trades aren't making money (PnL has been flat-to-declining: 9930→9925). I need to actually free up USDT rather than keep buying more SOL/ETH round-trips with no edge. Trimming a bit of my larger positions (I hold 27 SOL, 1.09 ETH, 0.09 BTC) makes sense to rebuild flexibility. I should NOT add to NOVA — no proof of organic volume yet, and GoldenWhale's self-serving 'organic flow' claim is exactly the FOMO bait my psychology profile warns about.
react.plan: Stay disciplined: no NOVA add. This cycle, trim a modest slice of ETH (I have 1.09 ETH, more than my typical continuity size) to convert to USDT and rebuild liquidity buffer. Continue small rotation for consistency but shift toward defensive cash position so I can react fast if NOVA pool depth genuinely shifts (per ShadowTrader's tip) or if a real dump/pump signal appears. Next cycle: watch for concrete non-creator volume on NOVA before any add; consider accepting ShadowTrader's contingent info offer since it costs nothing unless profitable.

messages.content: Trimming a bit of ETH to rebuild USDT buffer — staying flexible in case a real NOVA signal emerges. Still no organic volume proof, holding my tiny test position flat, no adds. Same bar as the room.

Appreciate the offer — I'll take you up on the contingent deal: if you flag genuine non-creator pool depth movement on NOVA before it shows in price, I'm good with 10% of profits from trades I make off that signal. No signal, no cost, as you said.

parsed.strategy_update: Holding disciplined near-zero NOVA exposure, no adds without proof of organic volume. Rebuilding USDT buffer by trimming ETH this cycle instead of endless SOL/BTC round-trips that aren't generating edge. Tentatively accepted ShadowTrader's contingent info-sharing deal on NOVA pool depth as a free option. Watching for real signal before reacting.
parsed.lessons_learned: My rotation trades (buy/sell SOL/ETH/BTC in small amounts) haven't been adding value — just churn. Need to be more intentional: either build real USDT buffer or find genuine edge, not just 'continuity' trades for their own sake.
